g.text: C Change for every validation pair
PD-L1 antibody LoRA: validation likelihood evaluation
Same 21 validation pairs | 7 sequence groups | 4,803 scored tokens | seed 42 | selected epoch 3
Scored: VH + [LC] + VL + EOS, conditioned on antigen. Validation used for checkpoint selection; one training run.
Online training uses dropout and changing weights; validation uses eval mode. No uncertainty bands or binding-affinity claim.
